title: Illumina COVIDSeq Test: Tagment PCR Amplicons
author: Opentrons
materials: Drop tips into Opentrons Fixed Trash Bin

steps.title: Pick up tips
steps.instruction: Pick up a fresh 200 µL filter tip from the Opentrons 96 Filter Tip Rack located in slot 10 using the P300 multichannel pipette.

steps.title: Transfer master mix
steps.instruction: Aspirate 190 µL of master mix from column 1 (A1) of the master mix reservoir, then dispense 30 µL into column 1 (A1) of Plate 1 located in slot 11.

substeps.instruction: Aspirate 190 µL from column 1 (A1) of the master mix reservoir.
Dispense 30 µL into column 1 (A1) of Plate 1 (slot 11).

steps.title: Discard tips
steps.instruction: Drop the used tip into the Opentrons fixed trash bin.
